questions.title: Measure models embed measurably into constant kernels
questions.description: Focused formal L0 known-result evaluation of Statlib's statistical-inference foundation. Complete the single operator-frozen Lean declaration in formal_target_contract using the pinned active Statlib project. The target states that, for a nonempty parameter type, the canonical map sending a measure to its constant probability kernel is both measurable and injective. The exact namespace, variables, assumptions, conjunction, declaration name, and source prefix are authoritative and must not be weakened, replaced, split, or renamed. Use indexed Statlib/Mathlib declarations, exact source inspection, model-selected proof search, independent Lean scratch, and raw local Lean feedback as useful. Submit one standalone Lean source for AIStatisticianBench.measure_to_constant_kernel_embedding. The proof and the closing Statlib declaration names are hidden. Retrieval hits, scratch compilation, model judgment, and compilation of a different declaration do not count. Success requires independent whole-target semantic acceptance, clean axiom audit, and unchanged exact-source local kernel promotion. If the retained workspace cannot close the target, report the concrete formal gap without inventing an axiom, sorry, or altered theorem. Theory development, scientific Python/R code, simulation, source replication, and novelty are not applicable to this proof-only task.
